observations: No new photos were provided after the seller’s reply.
The only available image remains photo 0: a PS-branded console back/outer shell; no ports, controller, games screen, serial/model label, or power-on test is shown.

claims.claim: Clean Sonny PS4 slim station with 8 to 10 games installed and one pad
claims.evidence: No photo/video of the games library or the included controller/pad.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: No inspection/warranty seal/serial/underside photos to support this.
Seller claims testing, but no thermal/fan/long gameplay clip is provided.
No close-ups of ports and no HDMI/USB/controller working demonstration.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt
claims.evidence: No controller/pad photo and no receipt photo shown.

claims.claim: “I tested it myself yesterday, everything I said is true. Please check again.”
claims.evidence: This is text-only; without new photos/videos it cannot be verified remotely.

risks.risk: Exact PS4 variant (slim vs other) is not confirmed from the single photo, affecting pricing and buyer expectations.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model/serial label (back/underside) and a photo of the front/side ports area.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic used PS4 with unknown variant.

risks.risk: Included pad/controller may be missing, non-original, or faulty.
risks.proof: Photo of the included controller(s) and a short clip showing pairing + working in the PS menu.
risks.if_unproven: Price as console only (no guaranteed working original pad).

risks.risk: Installed games count/storage may not match the claim.
risks.proof: Photo/video of the PS4 home screen showing the installed games library and storage capacity.
risks.if_unproven: Price as console with no guaranteed installed games.

risks.risk: Ports may be faulty or intermittent (HDMI/USB/controller ports).
risks.proof: Short video demonstrating HDMI output to TV and at least one USB device/controller connected and working.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully functional/unknown port reliability.

risks.risk: Overheating/thermal issues may exist despite the claim.
risks.proof: 10–15 minute gameplay/benchmark clip showing no shutdowns plus fan behavior; ideally with a temperature readout app.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potential overheating risk (worst case).

risks.risk: “Never opened or repaired” may be false.
risks.proof: Photos of any warranty/void stickers (if present) and a clear underside/serial label; internal seal photos if accessible.

proof_requests: Send clear photos of the model/serial label (back/underside) to confirm the exact PS4 variant.
Send photos of the included controller/pad(s) and a short clip showing it working (pairing + menu navigation).
Send a photo/video of the PS4 home screen showing installed games and storage capacity.
Send close-up photos of all ports and a short HDMI output + USB/controller working demonstration.
Send a 10–15 minute gameplay/thermal test clip (or at least a fan/temperature behavior clip) to support the no-overheating claim.
response.reason: The seller’s text claim of testing cannot be verified without new photos/videos. With only photo 0 available, key value drivers (exact model, included pad, installed games, port functionality, overheating test, receipt) remain unproven, so a confident worst-case price isn’t possible.
